blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Kings of P-pop SB19 is set to make its Coachella debut in 2027. The festival organizers unveiled the 2027 lineup on Tuesday, November 10, confirming the group’s scheduled performance on April 10 and 17 at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. The group also announced the milestone in a Facebook post on the same day. “See you on the other side of the desert, A’TIN!” SB19 wrote. Composed of Pablo, Josh, Stell, Ken, and Justin, SB19 will perform on both Saturdays of the two-weekend festival, sharing the same lineup with international acts such as Adéla […]...
